purpose: Teach: メタデータ/主眼/採る/価額/常設/工学科/多面/製作所

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査資料のメタデータを管理されてますね
lines.en: The police manage metadata on investigation documents, don't they?
lines.style: Warm, observational opening. Respectful tone suggesting genuine interest. Soft question-mark lilt at the end—inviting confirmation without pressure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査の主眼を被害者保護に置かれますね
lines.en: The police place the focus of investigations on victim protection, don't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, affirming nod in the voice. Slight emphasis on 'victim protection' to show understanding of priorities. Steady, sincere delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、優秀な人材を地域から採る方針ですね
lines.en: The police recruit talented people from the local community, don't they?
lines.style: Conversational, genuine appreciation in the tone. Light rise on the question tag—collaborative, not challenging. Warm recognition of good practice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、押収品の価額評価もご担当ですね
lines.en: The police also handle the valuation of seized property, don't they?
lines.style: Interested, matter-of-fact. Acknowledging the breadth of police work without fanfare. Slight upswing at the end—another piece fitting into the larger picture.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、駐在所の常設展示で防犯啓発されますね
lines.en: The police do crime prevention outreach through permanent displays at local stations, don't they?
lines.style: Genuine discovery in the voice. Warm appreciation for the community-facing work. Steady pace, conversational rhythm.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、工学科卒の鑑識官も活躍されてますね
lines.en: Engineering graduates work as forensic specialists in the police force too, don't they?
lines.style: Surprised-but-pleased inflection. Light emphasis on 'engineering graduates'—noticing the interdisciplinary approach. Affirming tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪を多面的に分析されますね
lines.en: The police analyze crime from multiple angles, don't they?
lines.style: Reflective, appreciative. Slow pace on 'multiple angles'—recognizing the sophistication. Quiet conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、地元製作所での盗難事件もご捜査ですね
lines.en: You're investigating the theft at the local manufacturing facility, aren't you?
lines.style: Shift toward the specific: warmer, more intimate. Leaning in slightly. Direct but gentle—acknowledging the real case beneath the conversation.
